**05 Jan 2026: Slow is Smooth; Smooth is Fast 🐌**

Going through my weekend routine, some decent moves to kickstart the year. However, price action still looks pretty tentative if you compare something like $QQQ vs $SOXX.

More trading is needed to see if the environment starts to improve and we get follow through. No rush to aggressively build exposure - considering where we've come from last year.

Have a good trading week ahead! 🔴
